title: Central Authority must pay audit expenditure
description: The Central Authority is required to pay expenditure incurred in connection with the audit of its accounts

content.what: must pay expenditure incurred in connection with audit
conditions: at such intervals as may be specified by the Comptroller and Auditor-General of India
limitations: any expenditure incurred in connection with such audit

aliases: audit expenditure reimbursement by central authority
central authority payment for audit fees
